notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Maraleaf Pixie.
Maraleaf Pixie does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Maraleaf Pixie by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Maraleaf Pixie.
Repeat for infinite {U}.
Activate Maraleaf Pixie by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Maraleaf Pixie.
Repeat for infinite {G}.
Activate Kinnan by paying {5}{U}{G}, looking at the top five cards of your library, putting a non-Human creature card from among them onto the battlefield, and putting the remaining cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat step 7 as many times as desired.
